item.title: Commuters Eat Free
item.description: Hello Commuters!!! Come join the Commuter Council on Wednesday March 25th 12 - 1 for a Free lunch and entry into our end of year raffle.

item.title: DIY Lip Scrub Night
item.description: Join the Social Work Association in creating your own lip scrubs to engage in self-care and creativity! All necessary supplies will be provided and snacks and refreshments will be available. All majors welcome!

item.title: WSSLM MEETING
item.description: Come and plan out some music events with us!

item.title: Midterm review
item.description: Come join peer mentor Chris, for a review on the midterms you took. This will help you to better prepare for finals, and finding your strengths and where you can improve to finish the semester and finals strong.

item.title: Commuter Council Tabling
item.description: Come learn about the Commuter Council and what we do in exchange for a raffle ticket for our end of year raffle.

item.title: Commuter Council Tabling
item.description: Come learn about the Commuter Council and what we do in exchange for a raffle ticket to our end of year raffle.

item.title: Emotional CARE Package
item.description: Join CARE Ambassador: Lorraine Fernandez, as she leads a workshop based on stress management, relaxation techniques, and practicing mindfulness as we head into finals! Snacks will be provided, all students are invited to attend!

item.title: Financial Aid CARE Package II
item.description: Students will learn about credit building, debt repayment, auto loans, and overall financial wellness with David Kinstle; Branch Manager from Polish National Credit Union. Bluetooth speakers will be given out as prizes!

item.title: Feminist Fair
item.description: The EGST Department celebrates Women's Month with the Feminist Fair!! Come join us for our annual event focusing on the struggles and triumphs of women worldwide, which is organized by our students. Monday March 30 11:30 am to 12:30pm and again from 1:40pm to 4:30pm. Tuesday March 31 from 11:30am to 2:00 pm. Ely Main Lounge 110 Refreshments will be served!!
